last_review.summary: AUTH-010-A meets the task and architecture requirements. It generates 256-bit secrets with Node cryptography, uses exact test/live prefixes, hashes the complete raw key with SHA-256, returns only truncated display metadata alongside the one-time raw result, remains stateless, and introduces no persistence, logging, networking, or out-of-scope changes. The deterministic build and Prisma validation passed.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
